description: T15 (design guidelines §2, 'faction = hue, type = silhouette'): a token without dedicated top-down art shows a high-contrast silhouette glyph for its unit's category in the middle of the base, where its letter counter was - res://assets/icons/unit_silhouettes/{infantry,tank,walker,beast,character,aircraft,mounted}.svg, white on a black keyline, tinted with the base's contrast colour - and the letter counter moved to the token's Label child, centred under the base in small bold outlined type and drawn beneath the tokens; the model that carries the unit's name plate shows the plate there instead (one text row under every base). TokenVisual.silhouette_category is the category, from the unit's keywords (body type first: AIRCRAFT, WALKER, MOUNTED, VEHICLE, MONSTER/BEAST(S)/SWARM; then CHARACTER; else infantry). The Silhouette child is the glyph's spec, painted at Layer 3 under every badge: texture, modulate = tint, scale.x = half-size / base radius, visible = painted. Dedicated unit art is kept and a tank keeps the generic tank sprite (its glyph is the fallback); walkers, aircraft and mounted vehicles get their glyph instead of that tank sprite. Fixture fullauto_pretrigger (Orks vs Custodes, 104 tokens); setup privilege: Ghazghkull gets his MONSTER keywords (as in the mirror_orks army data) and his second model steps off his base, so the board holds all seven categories. Tier A: every token's silhouette_category matches this scenario's own keyword table (104 tokens, all 7 categories); named units (Boyz / Witchseekers infantry, Caladius tank, dreadnoughts walker, Wazbom aircraft, jetbike Shield-Captain mounted, Warboss / Shield-Captain character, Ghazghkull beast); every token has a Silhouette whose texture is its category's 256 px SVG, painted exactly when the token has no art and is not a tank with the tank sprite (86 painted, 18 keep art); every Label is the unit's letter, under the base, centred, 13 px Rajdhani Bold outlined, z -1 (80 letters), or empty on the 24 name-plate models; the named letter labels have text pixels on screen. T15_before rebuilds the pre-T15 token from the specs (glyph not painted, Label back to the old model-number stub) - measured pixel-identical (0.0%) over the whole board area to the old build's render of this frame; token_center (Warboss Beta) diffs > 25% (measured 59.5%). Template match: every painted glyph fully in view agrees with its own SVG at >= 90% of the sample points at zoom 1.0 (66 glyphs over three frames, plus the Caladius' tank glyph on its fallback path) and >= 80% at zoom 0.5 (77 glyphs over two frames, plus the tank glyph); the same check fails on the pre-T15 letter counters. T15_zoom1_*, T15_tank_glyph_fallback, T15_zoom05, T15_zoom05_right and T15_zoom05_tank_glyph_fallback frame the board for the Tier B review.

steps.comment: Decline the movement-phase-start stratagem window so no dialog covers the board.

steps.script:
# Setup privilege: this fixture lists Ghazghkull Thraka as INFANTRY; give him
# his MONSTER datasheet keywords (as in the mirror_orks_postdeploy army data) so
# one board holds all seven categories, then rebuild the tokens as a load does.
var u = GameState.state["units"]["U_GHAZGHKULL_THRAKA_A"]
u["meta"]["keywords"] = ["ORKS", "MONSTER", "CHARACTER", "EPIC HERO", "WARBOSS", "GHAZGHKULL THRAKA"]
# ...and stand his second model (Makari, 25 mm) beside his 80 mm base instead
# of on its rim, so his glyph is not half covered.
u["models"][1]["position"] = {"x": 3790.0, "y": 800.0}
tree.root.get_node("Main")._recreate_unit_visuals()
return u["meta"]["keywords"].has("MONSTER")

steps.comment: Close view x2.5: Warboss Alpha (left) and Warboss Beta (right, token_center).
steps.script:
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
m.view_rotation = 0.0
m.view_zoom = 2.5
m.view_offset = Vector2(430, 800) - Vector2(930, 560) / 2.5
m.update_view_transform()
return m.view_zoom

# The pre-T15 token, rebuilt from the specs: glyph not painted (the token falls
# back to its centred letter counter / tank sprite) and the Label back to the
# old model-number stub (default font, 16 px, no outline, z 0, at (-6, 12)
# inside the base). Measured pixel-identical to the old build's render of this frame.
var n = 0
for t in tree.root.get_node("Main/BoardRoot/TokenLayer").get_children():
	if not t.has_meta("unit_id"):
		continue
	t.get_node("Silhouette").visible = false
	var l = t.get_node("Label")
	l.remove_theme_font_override("font")
	l.remove_theme_color_override("font_outline_color")
	l.remove_theme_constant_override("outline_size")
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
	l.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.95, 0.95, 0.95, 1.0))
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
	l.z_index = 0
	l.text = str(t.model_number)
	l.size = Vector2.ZERO
	l.position = Vector2(-6, 12)
	t.queue_redraw()
	n += 1
return n

steps.comment: Falsifiability: on the pre-T15 frame the template match FAILS (the letter counter is not the glyph).

steps.script:
# Back to the live T15 token: the glyph spec and the letter label are rebuilt
# by the token's own update path.
var n = 0
for t in tree.root.get_node("Main/BoardRoot/TokenLayer").get_children():
	if not t.has_meta("unit_id"):
		continue
	t._t15_update_silhouette()
	t._t15_sync_letter_label(true)
	t.queue_redraw()
	n += 1
return n
